stages.title: Estimate or supply density ratios
stages.premise: Source and target laws are named, with common conditional outcome law.
stages.input: covariates and class labels / explicit laws
stages.purpose: Separate ratio arithmetic from fitted-ratio correctness.
stages.invariant: IID law gives ratio 1 after class-prior correction.

pseudocode.text: w(x) = p_target(x) / p_source(x)
Estimated w(x) = exp(classifier_log_odds(x)) * n_source/n_target

stages.takeaway: Exact ratio arithmetic passes for supplied laws; this does not certify a learned ratio.

stages.title: Normalize bank and query masses together
stages.premise: Only a common positive scale factor is irrelevant.
stages.invariant: Scaling BOTH inputs leaves crossings, threshold and ESS unchanged.

pseudocode.text: c = max_i w_i
w_i <- w_i/c; t <- t/c

stages.takeaway: Finite-threshold arithmetic is identical. Refusal-policy equivalence is a separate fixture.

stages.title: Check support and choose query mass
stages.premise: Zero support cannot be repaired by an epsilon denominator.
stages.input: source support, bank weights, query point/population
stages.output: finite query mass or upstream refusal
stages.purpose: Separate structural refusal from finite-bank posterior refusal.
stages.invariant: Target-only support is infinite ratio, never a fabricated finite weight.

pseudocode.text: if query action has zero source support: refuse before calibration
scalar mode uses target mean weight; per-row mode uses that row's own weight

stages.takeaway: A sufficiently large query atom gives infinity even though all observed scores are finite.

stages.title: Report weight concentration (ESS)
stages.premise: Kish ESS is a weight-concentration summary, not a coverage certificate.
stages.invariant: ESS=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2); uniform ESS=n and concentrated ESS approaches 1.

pseudocode.text: ESS = (sum_i w_i)^2 / sum_i w_i^2

stages.takeaway: Concentration reduces ESS; raising ESS by manually clipping changes the target weighting. No native clipping stage is claimed.

stages.title: State clipping status explicitly
stages.premise: Native calibration and this IW ratio path do not clip supplied weights.
stages.output: same ratios up to common scale
stages.purpose: Avoid attributing a manually clipped sensitivity input to production code.
stages.invariant: Rescaling is not clipping; no ratio cap is introduced by these functions.

pseudocode.text: No importance-weight clipping operation is present in this path
Manual cap experiment is a separate changed-input sensitivity control

stages.takeaway: Concentration reduces ESS; raising ESS by manually clipping changes the target weighting. No native clipping stage is claimed.

stages.title: Freeze residual scale and held-out scores
stages.premise: A frozen eta and positive residual unit are available; no scale network is trained in these fixtures.
stages.input: residual y-q, eta, u, random key
stages.purpose: Check scale/score bookkeeping separately from learning.
stages.invariant: IID restricts the distribution ratio, not the magnitude of these scores.

pseudocode.text: sigma_i = max(eta_i, 1e-6) * u
s_i = abs(residual_i) / sigma_i
Freeze scale parameters and unit at refresh

stages.takeaway: IID does not imply small normalized error or low penalty. High absolute residual with proportionally larger unit can have the same dose as the low-residual case.

stages.title: Select empirical and posterior thresholds
stages.premise: Scores and weights frozen; posterior draw stream recorded.
stages.input: scores, w, t, alpha, beta, exponentials
stages.purpose: Verify threshold arithmetic against direct tail-risk enumeration.
stages.invariant: R=max(lambda_hat,lambda_hpd); each posterior draw includes the query atom at worst-case loss.

pseudocode.text: lambda_hat = smallest observed score with weighted empirical tail <= alpha
draw mass_i = w_i E_i; unseen_mass = t E_query
crossing = smallest score with (tail_mass+unseen_mass)/total_mass <= alpha; else infinity
lambda_hpd = beta order statistic of crossings; R=max(lambda_hat,lambda_hpd)

stages.takeaway: A sufficiently large query atom gives infinity even though all observed scores are finite.

stages.title: Look up each row's threshold
stages.premise: Every grid point uses the same posterior draw stream.
stages.input: bank scores/weights, query-mass grid and row masses
stages.purpose: Keep query mass separate from calibration weight normalization.
stages.invariant: R(t) does not decrease; lookup rounds t upward and refuses values beyond the grid.

pseudocode.text: tabulate R(t) on ascending mass grid with coupled random draws
choose first grid mass >= query mass; take its threshold

stages.takeaway: The fixed sample demonstrates monotonic arithmetic and conservative lookup, not target-population coverage.

stages.title: Convert threshold to half-width
stages.premise: The reference has frozen positive unit and predicted scale.
stages.purpose: Separate normalized threshold from response units.
stages.invariant: U is a half-width, not the full interval width 2U.

pseudocode.text: U_i = R_i * max(eta_i,1e-6) * u

stages.takeaway: IID does not imply small normalized error or low penalty. High absolute residual with proportionally larger unit can have the same dose as the low-residual case.

stages.title: Convert finite width to bounded dose
stages.premise: Blend is fixed in [0,1]; width and residual unit are valid.
stages.purpose: Check penalty direction independently of coverage and host placement.
stages.invariant: Finite dose=1+blend*U/(U+u), lies in [1,1+blend]; native unsupported row uses dose 1.

pseudocode.text: supported = valid and usable and finite(U)
dose = 1 + blend*U/(U+u) on supported rows; native fallback=1
stop_gradient(dose)

stages.takeaway: IID does not imply small normalized error or low penalty. High absolute residual with proportionally larger unit can have the same dose as the low-residual case.

stages.title: Apply explicit refusal policy
stages.premise: A ready reference and infinite row threshold indicate refusal.
stages.purpose: Expose a policy difference that can remain even with unit ratios.
stages.invariant: TD3/ReBRAC/CQL: native=1, most-caution=1.5 at blend=.5; IQL has its own rule.

pseudocode.text: if refused and most_caution: TD3/ReBRAC/CQL dose=1+blend
IQL native refusal weight=0; most-caution positive-advantage weight=1

stages.takeaway: A penalty increase at refusal can be caused entirely by the refusal rule, even when all importance weights are one. Do not attribute it to ratio weighting.

stages.title: Attach detached multiplier and assess alignment
stages.premise: Host placement is source-audited; these fixtures do not run a host update.
stages.input: dose/actor weight and known diagnostic oracle
stages.purpose: Distinguish arithmetic correctness from useful caution.
stages.invariant: Dose boundary has zero gradient; correct arithmetic alone need not rank actual error or harm.

pseudocode.text: Use detached coefficient in the host location documented by the source audit
Compare dose/width to known absolute Q error and action disadvantage independently

stages.takeaway: Checks stop-gradient ownership at the dose boundary. This does not execute any host optimizer update.

stages.title: Reject invalid reference inputs
stages.premise: Positive finite unit and valid scale/residual arrays are required.
stages.purpose: Keep malformed arithmetic out of deployment.
stages.invariant: Invalid helper refresh cannot become ready; upstream state-preservation is outside this fixture.

stages.takeaway: The helper returns an invalid/not-ready reference; caller preservation of a previous state is source-audited separately.

stages.title: Exploratory clipped-command mixed-measure contract
stages.premise: The target clips Gaussian noise and clips actions; its continuous-law distribution includes singular boundary mass.
stages.input: Target spread, clipping boundaries, continuous source mixture, query action
stages.purpose: Distinguish a reproducible code path from an exact target-density claim.
stages.invariant: A continuous-density ratio must account for every target measure component or explicitly refuse target-only mass.

pseudocode.text: Source eps=1 is uniform continuous density 1/16 on four-dimensional action box.
Target sampler clips noise to +/-0.5 then action to +/-1, creating positive boundary mass.
Legacy spread formula uses only Gaussian interior density; -inf mass is replaced by a small floor.
Fixture reproduces both non-refusal branches; exact continuous-law contract fails.

stages.takeaway: Two harness passes expose two scientific contract failures, isolated to the exploratory command-weighted density path.
